name: Jazz Bear
source:
A vintage store. A smug customer. A cursed loop of deaths. A bear who loves jazz. A shopkeeper who smiles like she knows everything. 

Escape is possible, if he figures out why the nightmare always starts in her shop.

[From [url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/jazz-bear]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一家复古店。一个自鸣得意的顾客。被诅咒的死亡循环。一只热爱爵士乐的熊。店主笑容满面，仿佛什么都知道。

如果他弄清楚为什么噩梦总是从她的店里开始，逃脱是可能的。

[来自[url=https://nothack-europa.itch.io/jazz-bear]Itch.io[/url]]
